finalText:
**It's a small Node HTTP service, five files, no dependencies.**

```mermaid
graph LR
  server.js -->|checks token| auth.js
  server.js --> routes.js
  routes.js --> cache.js
  routes.js --> store.js
  cache.js --> store.js
```

`server.js` takes the request and rejects anyone without a valid token. `auth.js` checks bearer tokens of the form `<userId>.<signature>`, signed with `AUTH_SECRET`. `routes.js` holds a three-entry table: read a user, list your orders, add an order. `cache.js` is a 256-entry read cache in front of `store.js`, which is a `Map` where records die 15 minutes after a write.

Two things to know before you touch it:

- `routes.js` says writes invalidate the cache, but `POST /orders` never does — a new order stays hidden until the cache entry is pushed out.
- `GET /users` reads whatever `id` the caller passes, so any signed-in user can fetch any other user.
